The address is now editable, with a guard against collisions.

**→ http://maker:4001**

**Please confirm:**

1. On any bookmark, click **Edit**. You'll now see a **Web address** field at the top of the editor. Change it — for example strip tracking text or fix a typo — and click **Save changes**. The bookmark updates (and its site name/icon follow the new address).
2. Open **Edit** on a *different* bookmark and try to change its **Web address** to one you already have (e.g. `https://github.com/tldr-pages/tldr`). Click **Save changes** — it's **blocked** with *"Another bookmark already uses that address"* (and it tells you if that other one is in Read later or Archived), so you never end up with two of the same.

Note: the app keeps the address exactly as you type it (it won't strip tracking text for you — you edit it by hand), and if you leave off `https://` it's added for you.
